sampling.observable_spin_turns_note: Physical spin revolutions ν_s·ΔN exist, but phase samples only resolve them if save_interval ≤ 1/(2|ν_s|).

nomenclature.mean_D_offset: ⟨D⟩_i − ⟨D⟩_ref after transient cut; tracking proxy, not theoretical Δδ_eq
nomenclature.delta_eq_theory: Senichev equilibrium momentum shift from ξ, η1, emittances
nomenclature.C_n: Phase coherence |⟨exp(iΔφ)⟩| at saved turns only
nomenclature.dnu_s_rel: Relative spin-tune estimate from unwrapped phase; None if aliased
nomenclature.aliased_phase_slope: Raw phase slope / 2π when sampling is aliased — not a physical tune
nomenclature.spin_plane: Phase = unwrap(atan2(Sx,Sz)); requires horizontal/longitudinal initial spin (psi_deg≈0). Vertical spin (psi=90°) makes this phase undefined.
